Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Next examination

The next Type II audit period begins 1 July 2026 and runs for 12 months.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Overview

Nimbus Labs completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering the Nimbus Ledger Sync platform. The audit period ran from 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026. The final report was issued on 14 August 2026 by the independent auditor Harlow & Pike LLP.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Results

The auditor noted two exceptions during the period:

One quarterly access review was completed 6 days after the due date in Q1 2026.One terminated contractor retained read-only access to a staging tool for 2 days after their contract ended.

Both exceptions were remediated and closed before the report was issued. No exceptions related to encryption, backups or incident response.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Access Control Policy > Principles

Access is granted on a least-privilege basis and tied to a person's role. Every grant has a named approver and is recorded in the audit log.
